# newui

A SolidJS component library built on **SolidJS + Zag + typed variant recipes +
Tailwind CSS v4**. It ships semantic tokens, a full component ladder, headless
data helpers, optional charts and editors, and a copyable application skeleton.

## Packages

- `@newui/tokens` — framework-neutral token data and the CSS-variable generator.
- `@newui/tailwind` — v4 `@theme` / `@utility` / plugins and `style.css`.
- `@newui/icons` — the icon set as Solid components.
- `@newui/atoms` — single controls and marks over Zag.
- `@newui/molecules` — compound interactions built from atoms.
- `@newui/organisms` — page regions: sidebar, filter bar, board, table, virtual list.
- `@newui/templates` — `AppShell`, `PaneLayout` and `AuthLayout`.
- `@newui/data` — headless formatting, selection, undo, downloads, query and forms.
- `@newui/charts`, `@newui/editor`, `@newui/code-editor` — optional chart and editing surfaces.
- `@newui/vite` — dev-server proxy, icon auto-import and DocType types.

## Conventions

- **Two color axes only**: `variant` (`solid | subtle | outline | ghost`) and
  `theme` (`gray | blue | green | amber | red`; Badge adds `violet`). State
  (error/disabled/loading) is a state prop, never a theme.
- **No `v-model`.** Overlays take `open` + `onOpenChange`; inputs take `value` +
  `onValueChange` (or `checked` + `onCheckedChange`). Uncontrolled via `default*`.
- **Every input shares the labelling contract** (`label`, `description`, `error`,
  `required`), implemented by `Field`.
- **Styling hooks are `data-slot` / `data-state`**, never class-injection props.
  Root `class` fallthrough is merged last with `cn()`.
- **Semantic tokens only** — `surface-*`, `ink-*`, `outline-*`. Never raw colors.
- Light/dark is the `colorScheme` axis (`createColorScheme`), not `theme`.
- Components are imported from their atomic package root; no component subpaths.

## Data

`@newui/data` exports formatting and selection helpers, undo and downloads,
`createDataClient`/`DataProvider`, `createCollection` over repositories, and
`createAppForm`/`Form`/`fieldError` over TanStack Form. `@newui/data/query` and
`@newui/data/form` are the two documented subpaths.

## Commands

```
pnpm dev             # playground
pnpm storybook       # isolated component surface
pnpm build           # package CSS and theme generation
pnpm test            # vitest unit, a11y and manifest suites
pnpm test:ssr        # Solid SSR smoke tests
pnpm verify          # the whole CI pipeline locally
pnpm verify:checks   # fast gates only
pnpm verify:e2e      # browser harness only
pnpm css             # regenerate @theme + tokens CSS after token changes
pnpm api             # regenerate api.json
pnpm site            # regenerate the component registry and API slices
pnpm docs:build      # render spec/*.md + api.json into a static docs site
pnpm skills:check    # validate Agent Skills and report staleness
```

Per-component contracts live in [`spec/`](./spec). The design rules live in
[`PRINCIPLES.md`](./PRINCIPLES.md), vocabulary in [`CONTEXT.md`](./CONTEXT.md),
and the agent-facing skills in [`skills/`](./skills).
